protocol.order: 20 rotating blocks of five fresh processes
protocol.search: prepared molecules; first and second calls timed per case
protocol.validation: RDKit checks parseability, input matches, and query graph predicates after timing; concrete molecules are converted to SMARTS
protocol.note: Every lane returns SMARTS; earlier chematic versions convert their concrete result within the timed search. RDKit parse includes first-use initialization. Query predicates are compared after conversion; invalid or differing results cannot support speed ratios.
